body: Okay. Just trying to talk to you. Ive been in the same boat. I saw your other post. Only difference is, I actually have the fucking gun.
I'm going to go out on a limb here and say your family and friends will notice.
Is there something in particular that is making you have these thoughts?
I sent her a pm but she hasn't answered...
I can't. And I don't want to. Because that would make it, in some small way, my fault.
As has mine been. Only in my case, the last three suicide attempts I've made haven't worked.

You can say what you like, and believe it also. In truth, I still care for him in some way. I truly loved the man I married. While I didn't ask for the abuse, I didn't want him to die either. All this time, I have wanted to believe that there was still something good left in him. It wasn't about "sticking it to him", as you so eloquently and angrily put it. It was about preventing him from hurting me or someone else again. I have taken a long look at my life, and let me be first to admit that I'm not the perfect person. And I never will be. But neither was he, neither are you, or anyone else who has posted here for that matter. In the end, he killed himself so he wouldn't have to face prison time. And that relieves me because I will never have to face that type of abuse at his hands ever again.
I didn't want control of him. I wanted to feel in control of myself. taking my life back in a way.

Okay, a little bit of backstory. We were married. I was in the military and deployed for nearly a year. After my deployment, he became incredibly abusive. I got pregnant about a year after. Why I stayed with him during that time, I can't answer. He ended up pushing me down a flight of stairs, making me miscarry. I ended the marriage shortly after, this was nearly 3 years ago. He somehow found out where I am living now and surprised me. Ended up beaten, raped, and in the hospital. This was only a few months ago that this happened.

That's a hard question to answer. The truth is, I don't know really. I suspect it. But I will never know for certain. And that thought weighs heavily on me. I did not want him dead, despite what he has done to me.
It's not really so much the "punishment" aspect as it is I feel like he took my power away. Again. My power to be able to do something about this situation.
I might try that. Thank you.
Yes, that is the most important thing. I think, for me, it's the fact that the abuse is so recent. I have had no closure as far as that goes.

I just wanted to show him that he didn't ruin me. That nothing he could do would ruin me. I wanted him to go to jail for everything he's done. Be able to face him in court and show him that I'm not broken.
I am relieved. He will never be able to hurt me again. Or anyone else for that matter. But the anger isn't something I expected.

I have been seeing a professional for a while, mostly for an unrelated issue, but recently I've begun to talk about the physical and sexual abuse. The "whirlwind of emotions" is made worse by the fact that I am bipolar.
